description: tmux: plugins install on first start, free Dracula status line, Neovim-aware pane keys, session save and restore, Ctrl-f project sessions

hint.linux: sudo apt install tmux (3.2 or newer)

hint.macos: xcode-select --install, or brew install git (clones the plugin manager and plugins on first start)
hint.linux: sudo apt install git (clones the plugin manager and plugins on first start)

hint.macos: xcode-select --install, or brew install python (runs session save and restore, and the sessionizer on prefix Ctrl-f)
hint.linux: sudo apt install python3 (runs session save and restore, and the sessionizer on prefix Ctrl-f)

hint.macos: brew install fzf (prefix Ctrl-f picks a project)
hint.linux: sudo apt install fzf (prefix Ctrl-f picks a project)
